step1_analysis.circuit_type: Sense Current Recovery / Bitline Clamping Circuit
step1_analysis.description: A differential amplifier with positive feedback used in virtual-ground flash memory to counteract side-leakage current. It injects recovery current into the bitline when the bitline voltage is above a reference, maintaining the high state for programmed cells.

paper_reference.title: Virtual-Ground Sensing Techniques for a 49-ns/200-MHz Access Time 1.8-V 256-Mb 2-Bit-per-Cell Flash Memory

Power.description: Total DC power consumption of the circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current from XM6 (W=5u, L=0.5u, Vgs=0.7V) is approx 100uA. Total power = 1.8V * 100uA = 180uW. With added testbench loads, approx 300uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard SKY130 NMOS current at given bias.

Trip_Voltage.description: Bitline voltage at which the amplifier switches state

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by CASREF, which is set to 0.9V in the testbench.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The differential pair balances when BITLINE roughly equals CASREF.

Response_Time.description: Delay from bitline dropping below reference to the feedback turning off

sky130_expected.calculation: RC delay of node A. With 10k load and ~50fF parasitic capacitance, tau = 0.5ns. Delay should be around 1-5ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the order of magnitude of the paper's 7ns timing metric, adjusted for a simplified testbench load.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC trip point, transient response time, and power consumption of the sense current recovery circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Sense Current Recovery Circuit Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

* DUT
XM8 N4 INI_CHGB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM7 N6 ENB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM6 N0 CAS_BIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM5 BITLINE INI_CHG GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM2 B CASREF N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 A BITLINE N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM4 BITLINE A N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM3 SAIN A BITLINE GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Testbench Loads
RA A VDD 10k
RB B VDD 10k
RSAIN SAIN GND 10k

* Bias and Supply Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VCAS_BIAS CAS_BIAS 0 0.7
VCASREF CASREF 0 0.9
VINI_CHGB INI_CHGB 0 0
VINI_CHG INI_CHG 0 0
VENB ENB 0 0

* Stimulus
VBITLINE_IN BITLINE_IN 0 PULSE(1.8 0 5n 1n 1n 20n 50n)
RBITLINE BITLINE_IN BITLINE 1k

.control
* DC Analysis for Trip Point
dc VBITLINE_IN 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc trip_voltage find v(BITLINE) when v(A)=0.9 cross=1

* Transient Analysis for Response Time
tran 0.1n 50n
meas tran response_time trig v(BITLINE) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(A) val=0.9 cross=1

* Operating Point for Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

quit
.endc
